name: Concord Drugs Limited
about: Concord Drugs Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical formulations in India. It offers tissue bio-adhesive products; ready-to-fill pellets and multiple unit pellets system; other drugs in the form of tablets, capsules, injectables such as small volume parenterals, dry powders, syrups and suspension, and dry syrups; and hand sanitizers. Concord Drugs Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
